provenance.graph_diagonal_proof: With all scalar Casimir graph currents assigned (d,d-1), the HL diagonal sets these currents and positive jets to zero. The potential lies in the square of the basic invariant ideal, so its slice derivatives vanish modulo the restricted invariants. The diagonal ring is therefore the nilcone intersected with the Slodowy slice. Flatness of the restricted adjoint quotient gives the regular sequence of basic Casimirs.
provenance.invariant_square_reason: The potential has degree p+1 > 6, the largest basic SO8 Casimir degree; every monomial therefore has at least two invariant factors.

generic_arc.method: Universal Noether/Euler/Koszul source-kernel lower bound; equality with the complete fixed specialization checked by the supervisor.

universal_source_kernel_bound.argument: Every base Noether vector annihilates each defining invariant as an exact polynomial identity, hence every invariant potential. Weighted Euler supplies another universal first-jet identity. Koszul pairs of every eligible jet relation are universal identities as well. Differentiation and polynomial multiplication give formal relation-source kernels. Sparse QQ elimination verifies their independence. The displayed matrix is evaluated at the recorded rational invariant coefficients. Its independent vectors certify a nonzero rational minor, so the corresponding universal vectors remain independent over the generic coefficient field. Free minus full source plus this kernel bound is a lower bound; equality with a separately computed fixed specialization is required before claiming generic dimensions.
